decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix builds on the firm's established nutrient-from-biomass offer, and its in-house R&D and university cooperation let it learn from early results, though a consumer food product sits at the edge of its engineering-centred knowledge base.
Modular extensions to its waste-to-energy plants draw directly on the firm's core engineering and prototyping knowledge, so it can readily interpret feedback and improve them.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant has its own web page and fits squarely within the firm's waste-to-energy expertise, which its own R&D supports, making it a strong candidate to keep.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's conversion technologies, and its research capacity and cooperation with research institutes give it the related knowledge to absorb early lessons and develop the plant further.
